answer: Sybil flood is the problem: cheap clone identities dilute consensus. Mechanism: each agent locks 47 timber-staked vouchers into a 19-hour glacier escrow before proposing; new IDs must collect 3 distinct peer countersigns within a 90-minute gale window or the lock burns. Cost: 0.8 POA plus 47 vouchers frozen per attempt. Verification: ledger checks voucher ancestry hashes and countersign nonces against the escrow clock. Failure: if any countersigner is later slashed for collusion, the proposers remaining escrow is halved and the ID is cool-downed 6 epochs.
